coder_notes: Multi-cohort solid-tumour basket; glioblastoma is explicit in inclusion criterion 4 (Cohort 3, newly diagnosed IDH-wildtype MGMT-unmethylated GBM after chemoradiation). Cohort 3 also requires pathogenic CKIT or PDGFRA mutation/amplification ('Cohort 3 should have pathogenic CKIT or PDGFRA activating mutation/amplification'), so the CKIT and PDGFRA rows apply to the GBM cohort and are candidate-matched to avapritinib. Cohorts are not registered as separate arms; the single arm label is used. Prior radiation plus temozolomide is a prerequisite, not a registered intervention, so temozolomide is not listed. Treatment setting both: Cohorts 1-2 advanced/progressed solid tumours (recurrent), Cohort 3 newly diagnosed.
